hooks.command: input=$(cat); if printf '%s' "$input" | jq -e '.tool_name == "apply_patch" and any((.tool_input.command // "" | split("\n"))[]; (((startswith("*** Add File: " ) or startswith("*** Update File: " ) or startswith("*** Delete File: " )) and endswith(".nix")) or ((startswith("--- a/") or startswith("+++ b/")) and endswith(".nix"))))' >/dev/null 2>&1; then jq -nc '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse",additionalContext:"A Nix file was modified. Run ./script/check.sh before continuing."}}'; fi
